articles.title: pnpm 12 RC 11
articles.summary: Minor Changes pnpm stage approve now approves several staged packages at once. Run it without a stage id to pick from the staged versions interactively, or pass a list of stage ids. The whole batch is approved with a single one-time password, and pnpm asks for a new one only once the registry stops accepting it. Inside a workspace, the selected packages are approved in dependency order, and a package whose workspace dependency could not be approved is skipped instead of being published against a dependency that never reached the registry.
